chunks: "Whoever spends a dirham on hajj, it is better for him than one hundred thousand dirhams that he spends in a rightful cause."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.دِرْهَمًا: a dirham; a small unit of money

ai.seo_question: Why is spending on hajj considered better than spending much more wealth in other good causes?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense virtue of spending wealth for hajj. It teaches that even a small amount spent in this act of worship can surpass a vastly greater amount spent in other rightful causes, highlighting the unique spiritual rank of hajj.
